latest.originalSummary: US company Sabanto has announced support for planters equipped with the Precision Planting Gen 3 20|20 system. Combined with a Sabanto-retrofitted tractor, the setup allows autonomous planting without an operator in the seat. Growers can supervise the work remotely through Sabanto’s Vehicle Mission Control (vMC) interface. Support is planned for the 2027 growing season.
